The epitope of the Fab on the KcsA T75G in the conductive state was determined from the crystal structure of the complex, solved by molecular replacement. The KcsA T75G channel construct results in a loss of the S4 ion binding site in the selectivity filter. T75G KcsA channel inactivates with a rate that was slightly (≈2-fold) slower than that of the wild-type channel, while recovery was significantly impaired. The Fab was used as a crystallization chaperone.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 2.3 angstroms
